change.title: OpenShift platform upgrade — not an executed change
change.purpose: Assess a requested OpenShift 4.18 to 4.22 transition. This synthetic plan has no validated upgrade path or resolved target patch.
change.scope: Cluster version, Cluster Operators, machine config pools, nodes and underlying infrastructure readiness; application image changes are excluded.
change.expectedOutcome: Reach an approved exact target release through a supported, cluster-specific update plan while retaining platform and application health. No implementation is recorded.
change.riskAssessment: Synthetic risk: degraded Operators, blocked node drains, storage dependencies and workload compatibility may disrupt the cluster.
change.securityImpact: Not assessed. Review cluster-level access, security configuration and Operator impact.
change.fallbackPlan: Proposed: record a version-specific, support-led recovery plan and backup/restore evidence. An OpenShift cluster version rollback is not supported; do not treat a Git revert as a cluster downgrade. No recovery has been tested.

evidence.summary: Illustrative change request from 4.18 to requested target minor 4.22; upgrade path, exact patch and approval are unresolved.
